card.name: Bracket before translated foreign title
card.fires_on: The opening bracket, parenthesis, equals sign or first letters of a title right after a foreign-language title, where an English translation or gloss comes next.

modes.label: Opening mark before gloss
modes.description: A parenthesis, bracket or equals sign right after a foreign phrase, introducing its English rendering.
modes.example: Deutsche Zeitungsbestände in Bibliotheken und Archiven<< =>> German newspapers in librairies and

modes.label: Start of a title or gloss
modes.description: The first letters of a title or translation inside parentheses after a foreign title.
modes.example: Confucion de los Confucions (<<Conf>>usion of the Confusions)?

card.writes: It pushes words about translation and translating, so the next text is likely a rendering of the foreign title.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a foreign title is about to be followed by its English translation.
